treaties.treaty_title: The Sluice Gate Accord of Lock 4
treaties.demarcated_territory: From Canal Lock 4 Siding North to Milepost 12 Culvert
treaties.tariff_schedule: 5% gross weight on dried salt cakes; zero tariff on potable artesian water.
treaties.treaty_articles: ARTICLE 1: The Canal Salvage Syndicate maintains exclusive diving rights to sunken coal barges in Basin 4. ARTICLE 2: The Weigher Compact shall provide continuous unadulterated salt cakes (minimum 98% NaCl) at a fixed parity of 1 kg salt per 5 kg dried peat fuel. ARTICLE 3: Armed sentries shall not cross the centerline of the Lock 4 bridge without 24 hours written telegraph notice.
treaties.penalties: Violation of water quotas forfeits all access to the Lock 2 freight hoist for sixty days.

treaties.treaty_title: The North Ridge Timber & Demarcation Pact
treaties.demarcated_territory: The crest of Mount Karkov from Birch Copse to Adit #4
treaties.tariff_schedule: 10% of cut pine square sets allocated to Garrison airlock reinforcement.
treaties.treaty_articles: ARTICLE 1: The Miners' Union holds unhindered right to fell timber in Birch Copse for mine drift sets. ARTICLE 2: The Garrison shall maintain two manned perimeter machine-gun posts to protect miners against rogue wolf packs. ARTICLE 3: No military press-gangs may conscript active union shovelers or timber framers.
treaties.penalties: Unauthorized timber harvesting outside boundary invokes immediate confiscation of all crosscut saws.

treaties.demarcated_territory: Gorge Substation #1 to Main Valley Busbar Pole 14
treaties.tariff_schedule: Fixed 4,000V AC transmission line fee: 2 liters turbine lubricant per megawatt-day.
treaties.treaty_articles: ARTICLE 1: The Hydro Guild shall operate the Lock 2 Francis turbines at constant 50.0 Hz +/- 0.2 Hz. ARTICLE 2: The Tempest Directorate guarantees unmolested transit for line repair crews along the 4kV pole line. ARTICLE 3: Priority power allocation: 1) Medical Clinic, 2) Blower Fans, 3) Radios, 4) Workshops.
treaties.penalties: Deliberate phase misalignment results in immediate disconnection of Directorate administrative bunkers.

treaties.demarcated_territory: Subterranean Level 4 Limestone Vault (The Memorial Crypt)
treaties.tariff_schedule: Zero tariffs; absolute immunity for all stonecutters and scribes.
treaties.treaty_articles: ARTICLE 1: The Memorial Crypt is declared inviolable neutral soil for all eternity. ARTICLE 2: Sister Mara and her apprentices shall inscribe every deceased human being without regard to faction, rank, or crime. ARTICLE 3: No weapons, ammunition, or military insignias may be carried past the stone weeping arch.
treaties.penalties: Drawing steel inside the Crypt invokes permanent banishment beyond the North Perimeter.

treaties.treaty_title: The Acid Gorge Chemical Supply Treaty
treaties.demarcated_territory: Sulfur Runoff Flats at Milepost 22 to Foundry Rail Spur
treaties.tariff_schedule: 50 kg refined yellow sulfur traded for 100 kg forged steel pickaxes.
treaties.treaty_articles: ARTICLE 1: Station 0 Chemist Ilya shall provide battery-grade sulfuric acid (SG 1.280) and vulcanizing sulfur. ARTICLE 2: The Silent Foundry shall cast acid-resistant lead-antimony pipes and valve bodies for the chemical lab. ARTICLE 3: Both parties agree to maintain joint hazardous containment barriers along the creek.
treaties.penalties: Failure of acid purity standards requires replacement of all corroded battery plates at supplier's expense.

treaties.treaty_title: The Cryogenic Seed Repository Demarcation Accord
treaties.demarcated_territory: Sub-level 3 Cryo Vault to Central Hydroponic Greenhouse
treaties.tariff_schedule: 10% of all viable sprout yields reserved for valley-wide seed hardening banks.
treaties.treaty_articles: ARTICLE 1: The Master Seed Vault shall not be unsealed for emergency food consumption under any circumstance. ARTICLE 2: Botanist Elena holds sole authority over germination trials and peat bed allocations. ARTICLE 3: The Miners' Union shall provide twenty tons of crushed agricultural limestone per season for soil de-acidification.
treaties.penalties: Consuming seed stock as grain carries immediate loss of voting franchise in the Valley Assembly.

treaties.treaty_title: The South Ridge Pilgrimage & Ash Way Treaty
treaties.demarcated_territory: The Ash Way trail from the Valley Floor to the High Cross Peak
treaties.tariff_schedule: Toll-free transit for unarmed pilgrims carrying burial urns or candles.
treaties.treaty_articles: ARTICLE 1: Unarmed penitents may climb the south trail during daylight hours without challenge. ARTICLE 2: Brotherhood elders agree not to preach against military airlock discipline during active fallout squalls. ARTICLE 3: The Brotherhood shall maintain trail cairns and emergency snow shelters along the pass.
treaties.penalties: Preaching civil disobedience at sentry stations closes the mountain trail for ninety days.

treaties.treaty_title: The Port Morozov Coastal Maritime Charter
treaties.demarcated_territory: Canal Lock 1 Basin to the Open Waters of Port Morozov
treaties.tariff_schedule: Standard maritime barter: 1 ton salt cod = 400 kg pig iron = 50 liters whale oil.
treaties.treaty_articles: ARTICLE 1: Black Flotilla steam tugs and diving scows have free mooring rights at Lock 1. ARTICLE 2: The Weigher Compact shall certify all trade weights on the dockside beam scale. ARTICLE 3: Flotilla navigators shall share coastal storm tide charts with inland valley scouts.
treaties.penalties: Smuggling uncertified scrap brass onto flotilla piers results in seizure of cargo scows.

treaties.treaty_title: The Valley Radio Spectrum Demarcation Accord
treaties.demarcated_territory: The Radio Spectrum (88.0 MHz to 108.0 MHz)
treaties.tariff_schedule: Zero fee; transmission power strictly capped at 50 watts ERP.
treaties.treaty_articles: ARTICLE 1: 99.0 MHz reserved for Tempest Directorate weather alarms and seismic telemetry. ARTICLE 2: 88.4 MHz allocated to Free-Net for community music, medical advisories, and lost dog bulletins. ARTICLE 3: 104.7 MHz reserved for The Keeper tracking and time pips. ARTICLE 4: All high-power radar pulses banned to avoid Harrow orbital retaliation.
treaties.penalties: Broadcasting above 50 watts results in immediate cutting of station feedline by sapper demolition.

treaties.treaty_title: The Silent Foundry Labor & Slag Accord
treaties.demarcated_territory: Sub-level 5 Smelting Hall to Slag Waste Adit
treaties.tariff_schedule: 500ml fresh goat milk guaranteed per foundry stoker per 8-hour shift.
treaties.treaty_articles: ARTICLE 1: Foundry shifts capped at eight hours during liquid iron pour heats. ARTICLE 2: The General Council guarantees distribution of sulfur-clearing goat milk and lard biscuits to all furnace tenders. ARTICLE 3: The Foundry Guild guarantees production of 500 railway spikes and 20 rail car wheels per month.
treaties.penalties: Lockouts or unannounced strikes forfeit the monthly foundry fuel allotment.

treaties.treaty_title: The Valley Medical Immunity & Epidemic Protocol
treaties.demarcated_territory: All District Clinics, Infirmaries & Decontamination Vestibules
treaties.tariff_schedule: Zero tariff on all pharmaceuticals, bandages, surgical steel, and insulin.
treaties.treaty_articles: ARTICLE 1: Dr. Sonya and her apprentice healers hold absolute freedom of movement across all sector checkpoints. ARTICLE 2: No patient may be refused emergency surgical care or triage based on factional alignment. ARTICLE 3: In the event of dysentery or typhus, the Healers' Cadre holds unilateral power to mandate 14-day sector quarantine.
treaties.penalties: Obstructing a physician carrying medical supplies invokes total boycott of clinic services.

treaties.treaty_title: The Valley Narrow-Gauge Rail Consortium Accord
treaties.demarcated_territory: Main Line Tracks from Coal Siding 4 to Lock 2 Terminal (28 km)
treaties.tariff_schedule: 1 kg coal freight fee per 100 kg of general cargo hauled over 10 km.
treaties.treaty_articles: ARTICLE 1: The Railway Corps shall maintain steam locomotive 'Buran' and 12 ore gondolas in operable condition. ARTICLE 2: Miners guarantee 10 tons of lump anthracite coal per week for locomotive boilers. ARTICLE 3: Track maintenance crews hold right-of-way over all pedestrian and dog sled traffic.
treaties.penalties: Tampering with rail switches or fishplates is punishable by permanent quarry labor.

treaties.treaty_title: The Orbital Kinetic Hazard Mutual Defense Protocol
treaties.demarcated_territory: Summit Optical Observatory & Subterranean Sky Armor Deflectors
treaties.tariff_schedule: Joint funding: 5% of all quarry shale allocated to vertical bunker armor strata.
treaties.treaty_articles: ARTICLE 1: The Summit Observatory shall continuously track Harrow-4 orbital decay. ARTICLE 2: Upon detection of kinetic dart separation, a 3-long-horn siren alert will sound across the valley. ARTICLE 3: All citizens must take shelter below -15m depth until the all-clear chime is rung.
treaties.penalties: Failing to maintain sky armor gravel depth results in mandatory assignment to surface shovel details.

treaties.treaty_title: The Valley Whole-Unit Barter Parity Standard
treaties.demarcated_territory: All Registered Valley Market Sittings & Trade Posts
treaties.tariff_schedule: Standard parity table: 1 kg Wheat = 200g Salt = 1 Box Matches = 2 Rounds 7.62mm.
treaties.treaty_articles: ARTICLE 1: All trade within the Valley of Tessarat shall be conducted in whole units without fractional fiat paper. ARTICLE 2: Harlan the Weigher and appointed municipal inspectors shall calibrate all market scales bi-weekly. ARTICLE 3: Adulteration of grain with sand or flour with chalk carries confiscation of goods.
treaties.penalties: Using shaved lead weights or false scale pans results in public exposure at the marketplace post.

treaties.treaty_title: The Valley Common School & Truth Archive Protocol
treaties.demarcated_territory: Central Schoolroom, Archive Vault & Public Tannoy System
treaties.tariff_schedule: Free education for all children between ages 6 and 16; zero tuition fees.
treaties.treaty_articles: ARTICLE 1: Every child in the valley shall receive instruction in reading, arithmetic, botany, and the history of the 45-Minute War. ARTICLE 2: The final log entry of Marshal Valery Rostok ('Do not rebuild rockets; plant wheat; forgive us') shall be read aloud at every graduation. ARTICLE 3: No political censorship may alter the historical text of the Standing Record.
treaties.penalties: Attempting to erase historical names or sanitize war causes forfeits all council representation.

treaties.treaty_title: The Great Charter & Perpetual Peace of the Century Seed
treaties.demarcated_territory: The Entire Valley of Tessarat (From High Ridge to Morozov Shore)
treaties.tariff_schedule: Perpetual free trade across all 16 districts; common defense, common harvest.
treaties.treaty_articles: ARTICLE 1: All sixteen currents of the valley are hereby united into the Democratic Commonwealth of Tessarat under the Forty Articles of the Slate Constitution. ARTICLE 2: The underground shelters shall remain open as municipal workshops and cold storage; all citizens hold the right to build homes in the daylight. ARTICLE 3: Sonya's Tree in the Sunken Atrium shall stand as the perpetual living emblem of our survival and our peace.
treaties.penalties: Taking up arms against the Commonwealth invokes perpetual outlawry from the valley.
